title: Q-KG-unlearn: knowledge graph of all unlearn data (DATAGRAPH-1)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** every executor run; DATAGRAPH-1
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/knowledge-graph.json::"unlearn": \{ "state": "built"
**Status:** open

DATAGRAPH-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): every Ultrastable system keeps a knowledge graph of all its data. The platform's seed tick Worker already does (seed/worker/src/datagraph.js). The unlearn system runs its own Worker in ultrastable/unlearn, so it needs the same thing wired there:
1. Import the core module from vendor/ultrastable/datagraph.js (vendored by doctrine/tenant-repos.json; source workers/core/datagraph/index.js). Never edit the vendored copy.
2. On the tenant's own clock (its cron or build step), pass every table or JSON collection it holds to extract(tables), then analyze, predict and insights. Tenants with D1 copy the pattern of seed/worker/src/datagraph.js (bi-temporal kg_nodes and kg_edges, writes only on change); tenants whose data is JSON in the repo build the graph at deploy time.
3. Serve /api/graph (built, last summary, series) and /api/graph/insights, public view only: counts, orphan findings, and records of kinds that are already public on the tenant's site.
4. Link the graph's findings back into the tenant's own queue (orphans, link leads), and name the graph on the tenant's front end.
Then set this system's row in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json to state built.
